notes: Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating hosted API for quick feature launch, then committed to Dedicated/VPC for production (data residency + compliance).

Background: product team (CTO + Head of ML) ran 2-week hosted API POC — quick integration via SDK, used for contextual help + snippet summarization. POC showed good quality but want dedicated infra for SLA and auditability.
POC metrics (hosted): 95th pctl response latency ~120ms for 512-token prompts, cost ~0.6c/token (rough figure provided by AE), batch embeddings throughput acceptable (250 reqs/min).
Dedicated ask: predictable throughput 200 qps (peak), target p99 latency <250ms for chat use-case, sustained embedding jobs overnight. Need reserved capacity + burst policy.

Security: strong. Must present SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO via Okta (SAML), audit logs with 1 year retention, KMS integration (customer-managed key preferred), US data residency (us-east), retention controls to purge PII on request.
Quote (CTO): "We like the runtime performance but cannot proceed without SOC2 artifacts + a clear audit log/retention story."
Network: Want VPC peering option or Private Connect for Dedicated control plane. Need network diagram and egress IPs for firewall rules. SE asked for sample terraform snippets for routing.
Commercial: preliminary pricing received 2026-02-28. Interested in 12-month reserved commit if SLAs and SSO/KMS handled. ARR target 50k-150k per year depending on final sizing.

Compliance review: Security team to run Redwood security questionnaire (sent 2026-03-03). Requested answers on data flows, encryption at rest, encryption in transit, key lifecycle, and third-party subprocessors list.
Can we provide: SOC2 attestation PDF, penetration test summary, list of subprocessors, sample audit logs schema + retention policy. Legal asked for SLA uptime target and indemnity language.
POC next steps: deploy short Dedicated proof-of-capacity (1 node equivalent) in staging VPC, run load script verifying routing/fallback, validate audit log ingestion to their SIEM (Splunk).
Internal notes: AE (Maya) to coordinate legal + security handoff. SE (Diego) to schedule VPC design call w/ infra on 2026-03-12. CSM (Priya) to prepare onboarding checklist if contract signed.
Risks: timeline slips if SOC2 evidence delayed; VPC peering complexity with their transit gateway; cost sensitivity on embedding-heavy jobs.

Stubs/refs: drive deck (pricing + architecture) shared, security questionnaire thread in Gmail. Fireflies ids for demo + security deep-dive attached above. Jira tickets raised for infra answers (INF-4872) and security evidence (SEC-1021).

Short bullets for quick view:
- Eval stage: hosted -> dedicated
- Needs: SOC2, Okta SAML, audit logs, KMS, US-residency
- Throughput target: 200 qps peak
- ARR intent: 50-150k
- Next: security questionnaire answers + VPC diagram
